note: Rwanda: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa or fee for 6 months (the East African Community), 90 or 30 days; everyone else gets a visa on arrival (or an e-Visa beforehand) for 30 days. Hong Kong's 1-month exemption (from Hong Kong's Immigration Department) isn't confirmed by Rwanda's list (taken as on arrival). Read from Wikipedia's copy.
